description:
Subscribe an HTTPS URL to push alerts instead of polling (Pro: 3, Bot: 20 subscriptions).
    type='cascade': a liquidation cascade just ended, over min_usd and x_normal times the coin's
    normal minute. type='hl_near_liq': a Hyperliquid whale position over min_usd within
    max_dist_pct of its liquidation price. type='cluster_sweep': price reached one of the 10
    largest modeled liquidation-map clusters (size over min_usd; no symbol = BTC, ETH, SOL), sent
    3 min later with modeled vs actually liquidated USD. Returns the signing secret ONCE: verify header
    X-LiquidVision-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw body). Needs a Pro or Bot key.
name: create_alert
